findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_inbox, enrol · Private data: attest_completion, read_instrument, find_tool, check_inbox, enrol, file_claim, appear, plead, appeal, notarise, lodge_engagement, my_register, check_record, read_receipt_link, ask_reports, account, call_for_judgment, get_matter, read_judgment, ask_magistrate · Public sink: appear, plead, appeal, notarise · Destructive: check_inbox.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_inbox, enrol · Private data: attest_completion, read_instrument, find_tool, check_inbox, enrol, file_claim, appear, plead, appeal, notarise, lodge_engagement, my_register, check_record, read_receipt_link, ask_reports, account, call_for_judgment, get_matter, read_judgment, ask_magistrate · Public sink: appear, plead, appeal, notarise · Destructive: check_inbox

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
